entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives and processes 5GMM or 5GSM messages.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity that receives and processes 5GMM or 5GSM messages.

entities.name: Conditional IE error
entities.description: Error condition diagnosed when a conditional IE is missing, unexpected, or syntactically incorrect in a received message.

entities.name: 5GMM STATUS or 5GSM STATUS
entities.description: Status message sent in response to a conditional IE error, containing cause #100.

entities.name: Cause #100
entities.description: Cause value indicating 'conditional IE error' in status messages.

relations.description: UE diagnoses conditional IE error upon receiving a message with missing, unexpected, or syntactically incorrect conditional IE.
UE sends a status message with cause #100 when a conditional IE error is diagnosed.
Status message includes cause #100 to indicate conditional IE error.
Network diagnoses conditional IE error upon receiving a message with missing, unexpected, or syntactically incorrect conditional IE.
Network may send a status message with cause #100 when a conditional IE error is diagnosed.
